testo:
■ You may summon this creature by paying Costicon. If you do, put this creature from the battle zone into your hyperspatial zone.
Speed Attacker
Double Breaker
■ When you put this creature or it attacks, reveal the top card of your deck. If its a creature that costs 5 or less, you may put it into the battle zone. If you don't, put it into your hand.
